prompt: How do I reset my account password?
expected_output: Go to Settings > Security > Reset Password and follow the emailed link. The link expires in 30 minutes.

prompt: What's your refund policy on annual plans?
expected_output: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase, prorated for any months already used.

prompt: My last invoice looks wrong, can you check it?
expected_output: Explain the extra line item on the last invoice (a mid-cycle seat upgrade) without asking the customer to repeat details.

prompt: How do I export my data before closing my account?
expected_output: Use Settings > Data Export to create a CSV or JSON archive. It is emailed within a few minutes.

prompt: Can I change my billing email address?
expected_output: Yes. Update the billing email at any time under Billing > Contacts.

prompt: How do I add a new user to my team workspace?
expected_output: Go to Settings > Team > Invite member, enter their email and choose a role. They get an invitation email.

prompt: Can I pay by bank transfer instead of card?
expected_output: Yes, for annual plans. Choose bank transfer under Billing > Payment methods; invoices are due within 30 days.

prompt: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
expected_output: Go to Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication, scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the code.
Common causes are an expired card, a wrong billing address or a bank block. Update the card under Billing > Payment methods or contact the bank.

prompt: How do I cancel my subscription?
expected_output: Go to Billing > Plan > Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the current billing period.
